narr: Heavy rainfall occurred during the late evening of the 29th into the early morning of the 30th as a low level jet interacted with a stalled front. Several locations received over three inches of rain with some reporting six inches in a 3-4 hour period.
ev: The little North Fork River at Thornfield reached flood stage impacting the low water crossing. The river rose four feet in a short period of time.
lsr: THE LITTLE NORTH FORK RIVER AT THORNFIELD REACHED FLOOD STAGE. THE RIVER ROSE 4 FEET IN A SHORT TIME.
